about.introTitle: Welcome to Gram Panchayat Pimpalkhuta Budruk
about.introDescription: Gram Panchayat Pimpalkhuta Budruk is an important part of the local self-government system. Its primary objective is to provide basic facilities to villagers and work systematically towards the development of the village.
about.introDescription2: The Gram Panchayat continuously works on village cleanliness, water supply, roads, education, healthcare, and the implementation of various government schemes.

about.visionDescription: To build a clean, beautiful, prosperous, and developed village where every citizen has access to basic facilities, equal opportunities, and a safe environment.
about.missionDescription: To achieve sustainable village development through public participation, effectively implement government schemes, and establish transparent and citizen-oriented administration.
about.responsibilityDescription: The Gram Panchayat provides essential services and carries out development initiatives to improve the quality of life of village residents.

about.cleanlinessDesc: Promoting village cleanliness, waste management, and public health initiatives.
about.educationDesc: Supporting educational facilities and encouraging education-related initiatives.
about.welfareDesc: Implementing various government schemes and social initiatives for the welfare of citizens.

about.developmentPoint2: Water supply, cleanliness, and environmental conservation.
about.developmentPoint3: Ensuring eligible citizens receive the benefits of government schemes.

intro.title: Working Together for Village Development
intro.description: The Gram Panchayat is a local self-government institution that works to address village needs, support public services, and promote development through community participation.
intro.descriptionTwo: Each representative and administrative function has an important role in planning, implementing, and monitoring village development activities.
intro.highlightDescription: Effective village governance depends on cooperation between elected representatives, administrative staff, committees, and residents.

roles.sectionTitle: Key Roles in the Gram Panchayat
roles.sectionDescription: Different representatives and officials contribute through their respective duties and responsibilities.

sarpanch.title: Sarpanch
sarpanch.description: The elected head of the Gram Panchayat who provides leadership and coordinates its functioning.

points.one: Preside over Gram Panchayat meetings and guide discussions.
points.two: Coordinate village development plans and priorities.
points.three: Work with members and officials to address public concerns.
points.four: Encourage transparency, participation, and responsible governance.

points.one: Assist the Sarpanch in Panchayat activities and meetings.
points.two: Help coordinate development and public welfare work.
points.three: Support communication between members and residents.
points.four: Discharge the Sarpanch's duties when authorised or required under applicable rules.

members.description: Elected representatives who bring the needs and concerns of their respective wards to the Panchayat.

points.one: Represent residents and raise local issues in meetings.
points.two: Participate in decisions and village development planning.
points.three: Monitor public works and service delivery in their wards.
points.four: Encourage residents to participate in Gram Sabha activities.

secretary.title: Gram Sevak / Secretary
secretary.description: The administrative functionary who supports the Gram Panchayat in its official and day-to-day work.

points.one: Maintain official records, registers, and meeting documents.
points.two: Assist with the implementation of government schemes.
points.three: Support administrative procedures and public information.
points.four: Coordinate with relevant government departments and authorities.
